verdict.rationale: Docusaurus provides building blocks rather than a ready-made interactive API reference. MDX lets authors embed React components, including third-party npm components, so interactive or runnable examples could be built by hand. docusaurus.new also offers a runnable in-browser sandbox for trying Docusaurus itself. Missing for 10: any documented interactive API reference or explorer, built-in runnable code examples, OpenAPI/API-doc rendering support, and hands-on corroboration.
